seo.description: Hatha, vinyasa and yoga nidra, breathing practices and spa rituals on Nukus St. Your first class is 90,000 UZS, memberships from 600,000 UZS a month.
seo.answer: Your Company is a yoga studio and spa at 54 Nukus St in Tashkent. A drop-in class costs 130,000 UZS, the first class 90,000 UZS, an 8-class pass 600,000 UZS, unlimited 1,100,000 UZS a month. Spa rituals from 350,000 UZS. Open on weekdays 7:00–22:00, weekends 8:00–20:00.

sections.label: The studio
sections.title: We don’t teach poses — we teach how to breathe in them
sections.text: The studio takes up a floor of an old house on Nukus St: two halls with panoramic windows, a spa room with a hammam and a tea room. We guide beginners with care, watch alignment and offer modifications for injuries. Mats, blankets and bolsters are provided, and we’ll give you a towel too.

items.q: I’ve never done yoga. Where do I start?
items.a: With “Foundations for beginners”, “Morning hatha” or “Yoga for the back”. Tell the teacher it’s your first time — they’ll suggest simpler variations.
Comfortable clothes. Mats, blankets, blocks and towels are at the studio, and the changing room has a shower and a hairdryer.

items.q: Can I practise if I’m pregnant or injured?
items.a: Tell us before the class. For injuries the teacher will give modifications; not every class suits pregnancy — we’ll find the right ones. For acute conditions, check with your doctor first.

items.q: Do I need to book in advance?
items.a: Yes, groups are up to twelve people. Book by phone +998 71 200-00-42 or on Telegram; you can cancel free of charge up to 4 hours before.
A drop-in class is 130,000 UZS, the first one 90,000 UZS. An 8-class pass is 600,000 UZS for six weeks, unlimited is 1,100,000 UZS a month.

items.q: Can I come just for the spa?
items.a: Yes, spa rituals are available without a membership, by appointment. Hammam with foam massage is 450,000 UZS, the “Silence” ritual is 780,000 UZS.
